author: Antonialock
body:
So I had a look at the different taxon conditions that the term is propagated to, I focused on eukaryotes.

I came across several mammalian entries that seemed overannotated - the protein had characterized physiologically relevant substrates, but then the authors either tested a "readout substrate" or tested the transporter with pharmacological substances, and the curator co-annotated to xenobiotic transport. I cleaned those entries up.

In a different condition, I was able to add GO curation for a fungal transporter involved in moving some secondary metabolite.

Hopefully these will help generalize the prediction to "transmembrane transport". It will be intersting to see what effect it has.
